parameters.query:
UPDATE pedidos SET motoboy_provider=$2, motoboy_order_id=$3, motoboy_tracking_url=$4, motoboy_fee=$5, motoboy_status=$6, status='SAIU_ENTREGA' WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING codigo, telefone;
INSERT INTO entregas (pedido_id, provider, provider_order_id, status, tracking_url, fee, raw) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $6, $4, $5, $7::jsonb);

parameters.query:
UPDATE pedidos SET motoboy_status=$2, motoboy_driver_name=COALESCE(NULLIF($3,''),motoboy_driver_name), motoboy_driver_phone=COALESCE(NULLIF($4,''),motoboy_driver_phone), status=CASE WHEN $2 IN ('DELIVERED','COMPLETED') THEN 'ENTREGUE' WHEN $2 IN ('CANCELED','CANCELLED','FAILED') THEN 'CANCELADO' ELSE status END WHERE motoboy_order_id=$1 RETURNING codigo, telefone, status;
UPDATE entregas SET status=$2, driver_name=COALESCE(NULLIF($3,''),driver_name), driver_phone=COALESCE(NULLIF($4,''),driver_phone), delivered_at=CASE WHEN $2 IN ('DELIVERED','COMPLETED') THEN NOW() ELSE delivered_at END, raw=$5::jsonb WHERE provider_order_id=$1;
